profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Twilio
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer passionate about technology, learning, building, and working towards improving the world through my work.

In 2019, I graduated from the University of Miami with my Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, with minors in Mathematics and Japanese.

My interests include distributed systems, scalable architectures, and conversational AI.
I also enjoy learning languages, reading history and playing tennis and soccer!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Leading domain specific RAG chatbot development, testing, evaluation, and improvement using Node, Typescript and tools such as Langchain, Ollama, and Pinecone. 
- Successfully integrated software from parent company with RVOH's systems, including cloud instances, databases, third-party vendors, and hosting platforms, while fixing vulnerabilities, tech debt, and improving logging / observability.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented myriad changes to Node + Typescript backend and the React coaching platform, enabling coaches to manage and provide better care to users.
- Designed and shipped critical features such as cigarette and vape tracking, clinical note-taking, integration with 3rd party payment providers, and flexible user ingestion service. 
- SME of backend monolith
- Spearheaded technical integrations with major health systems such as MSK and Froedtert.
- Many other roles that come with working at an early stage startup (chief Cuban coffee maker)
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PostgreSQL

company.name: Vincere Health™ - Acquired by RVO Health

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked as part of a team leveraging AWS S3, Lambda, Amazon Connect, Lex, and Polly to build a pilot project as part of an effort to integrate NLP and automation into the customer calling experience.
- Leveraged Node, Vue, and inner-sourced tools to create a responsive, user-friendly experience for agents and customers.
- Hands-on experience with unit testing, integration testing, accessibility testing, and performance testing, among others.

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Translated hi-fi wireframes into functioning pages using React + Javascript.
- Triaged, diagnosed, and fixed bugs to improve UX.

positions.title: Summer Technology Analyst Intern
positions.description: -Built a UI to help streamline internal processes with developers as end users, on React, Spring Boot, and an internal React toolkit, while learning all technologies on the job.

positions.title: Senior Computer Operator
positions.description:
• Redesigned and implemented changes to the county website using HTML and CSS.
• Wrote critical macros in VB to help streamline and speed up workflow, collectively saving weeks of work.
• Entering, verifying, and maintaining student standardized assessment records.
• Troubleshooting and discussing hardware and software hurdles for coworkers looking for creative solutions.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.locationName: US Coast Guard Base Miami Beach
positions.description: Shadowed officers and enlisted personnel, performed various administrative tasks, such as learning to navigate using charts, and manual tasks, such as painting and cleaning.
